description: Signed acceptance receipt: which deterministic tests a delivered output passed — Runs your deterministic acceptance tests (equals, exists, absent, type, contains, length and number ranges, one-of, sha256, a JSON Schema subset) against a sub-agent's or vendor's JSON output at JSON Pointer paths, and returns per-test results plus a hub-signed receipt over the output hash, the tests hash and the results. label.description: Free text bound into the receipt, e.g. the task id.

output.description: The delivered JSON (at most 262144 bytes as JCS).

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into output; empty or omitted = the whole output.

value.description: equals/not-equals/contains: the JSON value; type: a JSON type name; one-of: an array; sha256: lowercase hex; schema: a hub-subset JSON Schema.

name: acceptance-receipt
